Interface Message

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
AcquireForecast, ActivateComponent, ChoosePlanet, ChooseShipPiece, DrawCard, EventMessage, FlipHourglass, GiveUp, GoNext, GrabPlacedComponent, GrabReward, GrabStashedComponent, InitializeCabin, JoinLobby, LeaveLobby, LoseCrew, LoseGoods, Ping, PlaceComponent, PlaceGoods, PlaceShipOnFlightBoard, RegisteredRequest, RegisterNickname, RejectComponent, ReleaseForecast, RemoveComponent, RemoveGoods, Request, RequestComponent, RequestNewGame, RequestRandComponent, Response, StashComponent, UseBattery
public sealed interface Message extends Serializable permits EventMessage, Ping, Request, Response
Represents a message that can be sent over the network via sockets. This interface is a marker interface for all types of messages in the game. It extends Serializable to allow messages to be serialized for network transmission.
